# UW Departments Web Server

> Centralized web hosting and publishing platform for University of Washington departments and academic units.

The UW Departments Web Server provides shared hosting infrastructure and web publishing services for UW departments, managed by UW Information Technology (ITConnect). It serves as a unified platform for department websites and web applications across the university.

## Key Topics

- web-hosting
- shared-hosting
- web-publishing
- departments-server
- University of Washington

## Getting Started
